entries.name: Jungle Hunter
entries.visualAnchor: Biomask argentée lisse, filet noir, cuirasse légère, plasma caster porté à l'épaule droite.
entries.prompt: Create one production-ready 2D pixel-art character plate of the exact Jungle Hunter Yautja from Predator (1987), using the supplied local photographs as the strict source of truth for anatomy, biomask geometry, skin pattern, netting, armor placement, dreadlocks and weapons. Show a single complete figure in a neutral alert stance, viewed from a clean three-quarter lateral angle and facing screen-right for a side-scrolling game. Preserve his tall athletic silhouette, mottled yellow-olive skin with dense irregular black spotting, black diamond body net, thick black dreadlocks with sparse gold bands, and the unmistakable smooth silver film biomask with broad domed forehead, narrow dark eye opening, angular cheek and jaw plates, and the small three-dot targeting assembly. Reproduce the deliberately sparse 1987 hunting armor rather than modern heavy plate: weathered bronze-gunmetal shoulder and backpack assembly, articulated shoulder plasma caster, forearm control gauntlets, right wrist housing with the full paired extended wrist blades, bone and tooth trophies, utility belt, rust-red loincloth panels, asymmetric thigh plates, knee caps and segmented greaves. Every modular object must remain visually separate and attached at the same body anchor shown by the references. Render exceptionally detailed cinematic 32-bit pixel art with crisp deliberate pixel clusters, restrained dithering, sharp material separation, scratched metal, organic skin texture and readable netting; no painterly blur and no 3D-render appearance. Keep the entire crown, biomask, every dreadlock, caster barrel, backpack, both hands, both wrist blades, loincloth, both legs and both feet fully inside the canvas with generous clearance on every edge. Use the same roster scale as the other film plates, approximately eighty percent of the portrait height, centered on one common baseline. The background must be one perfectly uniform flat #00FF00 chroma key with no gradient, texture, floor or reflected green light. No cast shadow, contact shadow, scenery, smoke, aura, border, frame, UI, text, caption, logo, watermark, extra figure, alternate head, detached equipment, invented weapon, cropped blade, cropped dreadlock or cropped toe.

entries.name: Greyback / Elder Predator

entries.prompt: Create one production-ready 2D pixel-art character plate of Greyback, the Elder Yautja exactly as he appears aboard the Lost Tribe ship at the end of Predator 2 (1990). The crucial narrative prop is the antique Raphael Adolini 1715 flintlock pistol that Greyback presents to Harrigan: show the entire recognizable flintlock clearly in his extended hand, with wooden grip, long brass-dark barrel, lock mechanism and muzzle all visible.
